terms.plainEnglish: The JSX attribute where React components usually put CSS class names.
terms.confusion: In JSX, use className instead of the HTML attribute class.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that turns an element into a flexbox layout container.
terms.confusion: Flex affects how the element's children are arranged, not the element's own text style.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that turns an element into a CSS grid layout container.
terms.confusion: Grid usually needs column or row utilities to describe the layout.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind spacing utility that adds padding on all sides.
terms.confusion: The number is from Tailwind's spacing scale, not always direct pixels.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that makes text use a small font size.
terms.confusion: Text utilities can control size, color, alignment, and more, so read the full class name.

terms.plainEnglish: A Tailwind utility that adds rounded corners.
terms.confusion: Rounded changes the border radius. It does not add a visible border by itself.
